text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a compact content plan for a hands-on workshop series that ties a benchmark narrative to a tutorial and sets up inbound lead routing. Goal: convert attendees into trial signups & doc contributors. :rocket:
jon: Love it. Suggest we map a 3-week cadence: 1) short benchmark story + key takeaways, 2) developer tutorial (ref app workshop), 3) live walkthrough + Q&A. Each with a distinct CTA.
alisha: For messaging, keep benchmark headlines quantitative (latency/cost delta) and the tutorial language very pragmatic — '10-min setup' + code snippets. I can draft hero copy. :pencil2:
sam: From events perspective, webinar -> gated handbook download -> product sandbox invite works. Need a short lead form that captures org size + use case. Avoid friction.
lee: Can we route webinar leads to a 'workshop' drip vs. generic nurture? Means we need tags and a routing rule in HubSpot / Intercom.
marco: I can add a tiny SDK sample and a mini refapp repo. Proposal: single Docker quickstart + a notebook for the benchmark steps. Repo name: redwood/workshop-benchmarks.
maya: @alisha can you sketch the funnel CTAs? Also need benchmark visuals: latency histogram + cost-per-1k tokens.
alisha: Yep. Draft CTAs: [1] "Run this benchmark in 5 min" (repo link), [2] "Get the workshop handbook" (gated), [3] "Request a sandbox" (sales-assisted).
jon: For the benchmark narrative, lean into predictable inference economics — show before/after (no cache vs cache + batching). Keep one slide with config details so engineers can reproduce.
marco: Repro snippet I propose (will add to repo):
```bash
# run benchmark (local)
python run_bench.py --model redwood-v1 --seq 512 --batch 8 --iters 200
```
sam: For lead routing: simple tag rules we can implement via Zapier or HubSpot workflows: webinar -> tag: "workshop_webinar"; handbook download -> tag: "workshop_handbook"; sandbox request -> tag: "workshop_sandbox". Then route to growth funnel / trial email sequence.
lee: Also add an 'engagement' custom field: "attended_demo" boolean from webinar attendance API so we don't recontact too soon.
content-bot: Reminder — set up UTM params for all links: utm_source=workshop_series&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=benchmarks_2026
maya: Nice. Next: owners + deadlines. I propose:
- alisha: messaging + landing copy (due in 3 business days)
- marco: refapp + quickstart + bench script (due in 6 business days)
- sam: webinar ops + lead form + routing (due in 6 business days)
- jon: benchmark slide deck + metrics (due in 4 business days)
If everyone's good I'll drop a brief doc and calendar invites.
alisha: Good with that.
marco: Ack, will create repo and PR today, aim for branch by EOD.
jon: I'll assemble slides and a one-pager for the sales team.
sam: I'll draft the lead form and the HubSpot workflow, will share a preview link.
lee: I'll configure the tags and add the engagement field to the CRM schema.
maya: Perfect. I'll create the tracking doc and a single source-of-truth checklist. Posting the doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcDEF_workshop_flow (mock link) :eyes:
content-bot: Note: please add event UTM to calendar invites and the registration page.
maya: Closing the loop — we'll do a dry run 2 days before the first workshop. Thanks team! :tada:
